from pathlib import Path
d=Path(sys.argv[1])
for name,(source,rows) in json.loads(sys.argv[2]).items():
 if not rows: continue
 lines=Path(source).read_text().splitlines()
 batch=[dict(id=f'{name}-{i:02}',kind='ordering' if name=='orderings' else 'claim',statement=statement,line=line,fragment=lines[line-1].strip()) for i,(line,statement) in enumerate(rows,1)]
 (d/(name+'.checks.json')).write_text(json.dumps(batch,indent=2)+'\n')
